window-1.title: WindowSwap
window-1.blurb: It drops you into a stranger's window somewhere in the world — ten minutes of someone's laundry line in Tellaro or rain on a Seoul balcony — and it's quiet, weirdly moving, and endlessly re-openable, plus it was built by a couple right there in Singapore.

window-2.title: Dirt
window-2.blurb: It's the culture newsletter that treats a Ghibli frame, a dead website and a pop star's tour merch with equal seriousness — exactly your brain, but in essay form.

window-3.title: Golden Hour Chrysanthemum Mocktail
window-3.blurb: It takes the dried chrysanthemum flowers sitting in your grandma's tea tin and shakes them into something golden and bar-worthy with maple and lemon — heritage drink, full persona change.

window-4.title: Barcelona Remodel by Conti Cert: '70s Style Redux
window-4.blurb: You already know how to commit to a persona, so here's a whole apartment doing it — '70s Barcelona reworked with real warmth instead of costume-y nostalgia, and about five ideas in here you could steal for one corner of your place this weekend.

window-5.title: MOZmoji 陌迹, Chinatown
window-5.blurb: You climb a staircase off Temple Street into a shophouse ceramics gallery where you get to pick your own handmade cup — each one modelled after a season or festival in the Chinese calendar — and then just sit there with cotton cheesecake and black sesame coffee like you live there.
